questions.question_text: In Captain America: Civil War, what is the name of the accords that divide the Avengers?
What is the name of the African tribe that challenges T'Challa for the throne?
What is the name of the device used by Scott Lang to shrink and grow?
What is the name of Thor's axe forged in Infinity War?
Which organization does Peggy Carter help found?
In Avengers: Age of Ultron, Tony Stark names the AI he creates from the Mind Stone — but what specific program within the Stone did he actually use as a template to build Ultron?
questions.clue_1: It wasn't built from scratch — Tony found something already inside the Scepter
questions.clue_2: The same programme later contributed to the creation of Vision
questions.clue_3: Tony describes it as the key to understanding the Stone — a pre-existing intelligence buried within, waiting to be unlocked
questions.hint_text: Think of the word for the fundamental logic that makes a mind work — not a name, but a type of code that mimics thought itself

questions.question_text: In Captain America: The Winter Soldier, HYDRA's infiltration of S.H.I.E.L.D. is revealed. Who is exposed as the most senior HYDRA mole within S.H.I.E.L.D.'s leadership?
questions.clue_1: He had been operating within S.H.I.E.L.D. since its earliest days
questions.clue_2: He is a World Security Council member — one of the most powerful men in the organisation
questions.clue_3: He personally oversees Project Insight and shares a long history with Nick Fury, who once considered him a mentor figure
questions.hint_text: His first name is also a common English word for a type of piercing tool — and his surname sounds like it belongs to a senator

questions.question_text: In Iron Man, Tony Stark is held captive and forced to build a weapon. Instead he builds the first Iron Man suit. What is the name of the terrorist organisation that kidnaps him?
questions.clue_1: They operate in Afghanistan and have cells across multiple countries
questions.clue_2: Their name is a reference to the Ten Rings — an ancient weapon
questions.clue_3: Their symbol — ten interlocking circles — appears on the hood of the man who takes Tony prisoner in the desert
questions.hint_text: Their name is also the name of the mythological weapon Wenwu wields — ten of them, worn on the hands

questions.question_text: In WandaVision, Wanda rewrites the memory and personality of an entire town. What is the name of the S.W.O.R.D. agent who first investigates the anomaly from outside the Hex?
questions.clue_1: She is a seasoned field agent with a personal connection to Monica Rambeau
questions.clue_2: She is not the director — she reports to Acting Director Hayward
questions.clue_3: She is the first person to physically enter the Hex and return — and each time she passes through, it changes her on a molecular level
questions.hint_text: Her first name is a common feminine name; her surname sounds like a word meaning brightness or radiance

questions.question_text: In Avengers: Endgame, Tony Stark solves time travel using a concept he works out on a holographic display. What does he write on the display that cracks the equation?
questions.clue_1: He figures it out while unable to sleep, tinkering alone
questions.clue_2: The concept involves navigating the Quantum Realm without getting lost in time
questions.clue_3: He scrawls the phrase on a holographic display in the middle of the night, then wakes Pepper to show her
questions.hint_text: He frames it as a personal journey — two words that suggest moving through something while staying anchored to where you started

questions.question_text: In Captain America: Civil War, Zemo's plan hinges on a specific date — the date of a HYDRA mission in which the Winter Soldier killed Howard and Maria Stark. What is that date as stated in the film?
questions.clue_1: Zemo discovers it in a HYDRA file from the Siberian facility
questions.clue_2: It is in December — a month associated with a certain holiday
questions.clue_3: The footage from that night is what Zemo plays in the Siberian bunker — knowing that Tony watching it would tear the Avengers apart
questions.hint_text: The date falls on the sixteenth day of the last month of 1991

questions.question_text: In Iron Man 3, Aldrich Killian reveals he was the true Mandarin all along. But what is the name of the extremis programme he developed — the biological enhancer at the centre of the film's plot?
questions.clue_1: It allows the human body to regenerate and overheat — but is dangerously unstable
questions.clue_2: The name is a single Latin-sounding word referencing an extreme limit
questions.clue_3: Killian first pitches the programme to Tony at a New Year's Eve party in 1999 — a meeting Tony dismisses, setting the entire plot in motion
questions.hint_text: Its name references the outermost boundary of human potential

questions.question_text: In Avengers: Age of Ultron, the cradle used to create Vision was originally built to house a different consciousness. Whose mind was Tony Stark trying to upload into the body before Ultron interfered?
questions.clue_1: This was Tony's plan to replace a system he had already lost
questions.clue_2: The consciousness in question had served Tony faithfully for years before being retired
questions.clue_3: Ultron seizes the cradle before Tony's upload can complete — forcing Thor to use the lightning of Mjolnir to finish the process instead
questions.hint_text: Tony wanted to give new life to an old friend — the loyal AI whose name is an acronym, replaced by a system named after a day of the week

questions.question_text: In Spider-Man: Homecoming, the Vulture's black market operation salvages and sells alien technology. What is the name of the company Adrian Toomes originally worked for before being pushed out?
questions.clue_1: It is a small salvage contractor hired to clean up after the Battle of New York
questions.clue_2: The company name includes Toomes's own surname
questions.clue_3: The company loses its contract when the Department of Damage Control — backed by Stark Industries — shuts Toomes's crew out entirely
questions.hint_text: It is a small business named after its owner — two words, the second being a word for recovering lost or damaged things

questions.question_text: In Ant-Man and the Wasp, the villain Ghost can phase through solid matter. What is her real name, and what caused her phasing condition?
questions.clue_1: Her father was a scientist whose experiment went catastrophically wrong
questions.clue_2: She was caught in an explosion that molecularly destabilised her at a cellular level
questions.clue_3: S.H.I.E.L.D. took her in after the accident and trained her as an operative — exploiting her ability while she lived in constant pain
questions.hint_text: Her real name is simple and feminine — her condition the result of a childhood accident in a quantum tunnel experiment

questions.question_text: In Marvel Comics, the Mind Stone was originally part of a set owned by a cosmic being before it became an Infinity Gem. What was the Mind Gem originally called in its earliest comic appearances?
In the Marvel Comics Civil War storyline, Tony Stark builds a Thor clone as a weapon. What do the heroes name this clone in mockery?
In the Marvel Comics, Charles Xavier's secret evil split personality — his dark psychic self — goes by what name?
In the Daredevil Netflix series, Wilson Fisk quotes a specific Bible verse in the very first episode to justify his vision for Hell's Kitchen. Which verse does he quote?

In the Marvel Comics, Tony Stark once had his entire brain wiped to prevent Norman Osborn from accessing S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secret files stored in his memory. Who eventually restores Tony's mind from a biological backup?
Which Avenger says 'We have a Hulk' in The Avengers?
In Ultimate Spider-Man, who is Spider-Man's mentor figure from S.H.I.E.L.D.?
In Spider-Man: The Animated Series, which villain uses a glider and pumpkin bombs?
What is the name of the book that contains dark magic used by Scarlet Witch?
In Avengers Assemble, which villain is often the main recurring threat across seasons?
In Avengers: Infinity War, Thanos defeats the Hulk in the opening scene without using any Infinity Stones. What move does he use to finally subdue the Hulk?
questions.clue_1: It is a close-combat finishing move — not a blast or a weapon
questions.clue_2: Thanos uses his bare hands and physically overpowers the Hulk with a single technique
questions.hint_text: The move pins both of the Hulk's fists — a grip so total it leaves the strongest Avenger completely helpless

questions.question_text: In Captain America: The Winter Soldier, Steve Rogers fights a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent in an elevator in one of the MCU's most iconic fight scenes. What floor does the elevator stop on before the ambush begins?
questions.clue_1: Steve realises what is happening before the doors even close
questions.clue_2: He offers everyone in the elevator a chance to walk away before the fight starts
questions.hint_text: The number is not significant — what matters is that Steve says something quietly menacing before the chaos begins: 'Before we get started…'

questions.question_text: In Black Panther, Killmonger defeats T'Challa in ritual combat at Warrior Falls. How does T'Challa survive — who saves him from death after being thrown over the waterfall?
questions.clue_1: T'Challa is found barely alive and taken somewhere remote to recover
questions.clue_2: The people who save him are connected to the Jabari Tribe
questions.hint_text: He is saved by the very tribe he once helped — their leader made a choice to repay an old debt rather than let Wakanda's true king die

questions.question_text: In Thor: Ragnarok, Thor and Hulk fight in the Grandmaster's arena. What does Thor say when he first sees the Hulk — the exact phrase that reveals he genuinely thinks this is good news?
questions.clue_1: Thor is excited, not afraid — he considers the Hulk a friend
questions.clue_2: His exclamation is a single enthusiastic sentence referencing a specific type of companion
questions.hint_text: Thor calls him something simple and affectionate — two words that tell you exactly how he feels about seeing a big green face in an alien arena

questions.question_text: In Avengers: Endgame, Captain America wields Mjolnir during the final battle against Thanos. He uses it in a specific way that no previous Thor film had shown. What new ability does Steve use with the hammer that Thor himself never demonstrated in battle?
questions.clue_1: It involves electricity — but not in the way Thor typically channels it
questions.clue_2: Steve uses the hammer to summon something directly from the sky without throwing the hammer
questions.hint_text: He calls down the storm itself — summoning lightning directly through the hammer without needing to hurl it, something Thor never did in quite that way on the ground

questions.question_text: In Avengers: Infinity War, during the Battle of Wakanda, which specific Black Order member does Okoye and Black Widow fight together — and who ultimately kills him?
questions.clue_1: He is a large, silent brute — one of Thanos's generals
questions.clue_2: He is defeated by a female Avenger using a distinctive weapon
questions.hint_text: He is the biggest and least-spoken of the Black Order — and he meets his end at the hands of Wanda Maximoff after she tears him apart with her powers

questions.question_text: In Captain America: Civil War, the airport battle features many memorable moments. What specific move does Ant-Man use on Iron Man's armour that temporarily disables it during the fight?
questions.clue_1: He shrinks down to do this — going somewhere no one expects
questions.clue_2: He gets inside the armour itself to sabotage it from within
questions.hint_text: He goes microscopic and crawls inside the Iron Man suit — targeting its inner circuitry by ripping out components from the inside

questions.question_text: In Thor: Ragnarok, Hela destroys Mjolnir the moment she returns. But where exactly does she intercept Thor and Loki — what specific location does this confrontation take place?
questions.clue_1: Thor and Loki have just retrieved Odin from somewhere unexpected
questions.clue_2: It is not Asgard — it is a place on Earth associated with rest and nature
questions.hint_text: Odin had been living peacefully at a cliff overlooking the sea — the confrontation happens moments after Odin says his farewell and dissolves into golden light

questions.question_text: In Black Panther, the ritual combat for the throne takes place at Warrior Falls. What is the specific rule that allows any challenger — even one from outside Wakanda — to challenge for the throne?
questions.clue_1: Killmonger uses this loophole despite not being raised in Wakanda
questions.clue_2: The challenge must take place during a specific ceremony — and the rule is that any person of royal blood may invoke it
questions.hint_text: The rule is rooted in blood — anyone who can prove Wakandan royal lineage may demand the challenge, regardless of how far from Wakanda they were born or raised

questions.question_text: In Avengers: Endgame, the final battle ends when Tony uses the Infinity Stones. Before he snaps, he says one final line to Thanos. What are his exact words?
questions.clue_1: It is a callback to something said much earlier in the MCU
questions.clue_2: Thanos had just said 'I am inevitable' — and Tony responds with something personal
questions.hint_text: He mirrors Thanos's phrasing but makes it his own — three words that complete a sentence beginning with 'I am', ending the entire Infinity Saga

questions.question_text: In Marvel Comics, the Power Stone grants the user omnipotent physical power. But in its first appearance, it was wielded by which Elder of the Universe?
In the Marvel Comics World War Hulk storyline, Hulk defeats nearly every major Marvel hero. Which hero does he spare specifically because of a personal vow he made — and does not fight?
In the Daredevil Netflix series, Kingpin kills one of his own men in a brutal car door scene in Episode 1. What is the name of the man he kills?
In Marvel Comics, Beta Ray Bill proved himself worthy of Mjolnir. Odin then forged him a new hammer of equal power. What is the name of that hammer?
In the Marvel Comics, Thor was once rendered unworthy of Mjolnir after a single sentence whispered by Nick Fury. What did Fury whisper to make Thor drop the hammer?
What is the name of Peter Quill's father?
What is the name of the dimension ruled by Dormammu?
In Captain America: The Winter Soldier, what is the name of the helicarrier project?
What is the name of Tony Stark's AI before F.R.I.D.A.Y.?
What is the name of the Collector's real title in Guardians of the Galaxy?
In Doctor Strange, Strange defeats Dormammu not by fighting him but by trapping him in a loop. What object does Strange use to create this infinite time loop?
questions.clue_1: It contains an Infinity Stone — one that controls time
questions.clue_2: Strange uses it to reset the moment of his own death over and over
questions.hint_text: The object is worn around the neck — a circular relic that Strange uses to rewind a single moment in time indefinitely until Dormammu agrees to leave Earth alone

questions.question_text: In Avengers: Endgame, the Avengers travel back to 2012 New York to retrieve the Tesseract. Their plan fails and the Tesseract ends up in Loki's hands. How does Loki escape with it?
questions.clue_1: A moment of chaos creates the perfect distraction for Loki
questions.clue_2: The Hulk causes an accident that sends the Tesseract sliding directly to Loki
questions.hint_text: The Hulk smashes out of a stairwell in a rage — sending the Tesseract skidding across the floor within arm's reach of a smirking Loki who immediately disappears

questions.question_text: In Loki, the variant Loki that the TVA captures is not from the main MCU timeline. What specific moment in time was this Loki plucked from — what had he just done when the TVA arrested him?
questions.clue_1: It happens immediately after the events of Endgame's 2012 time heist
questions.clue_2: He had just used an object he was never supposed to have
questions.hint_text: He was snatched the very moment he grabbed the Tesseract and vanished from 2012 — a branch in the timeline the TVA could not allow to exist

questions.question_text: In Captain America: The First Avenger, Steve Rogers crashes the Valkyrie into the Arctic to prevent a catastrophe. How many years does he spend frozen before being found?
questions.clue_1: He crashes in 1945 and wakes up in the modern MCU
questions.clue_2: The gap is long enough for everyone he knew to have aged or died
questions.hint_text: He slept through more than six decades — waking up to a world so changed that even a simple newscast left him completely disoriented

questions.question_text: In Spider-Man: Far From Home, Nick Fury assigns Mysterio as a key ally to Peter Parker. At the end of the film it is revealed that the Nick Fury Peter spoke to throughout was not the real Fury. Who was it?
questions.clue_1: The real Nick Fury was off-planet the entire time
questions.clue_2: The impersonator is a Skrull — one seen in a previous MCU film
questions.hint_text: He first appeared in Captain Marvel — a Skrull whose trust in Fury goes back decades and who was left in charge of Earth operations while the real Fury vacationed in space

questions.question_text: In Avengers: Endgame, Tony Stark and Steve Rogers travel to 1970 to retrieve the Tesseract and Pym Particles. Tony accidentally encounters his father Howard Stark. What alias does Tony use when speaking to Howard?
questions.clue_1: Tony uses a fake name that is not his own
questions.clue_2: The name is a subtle nod to a Marvel Comics character and is clearly improvised
questions.hint_text: Tony invents a name on the spot — a common first name paired with a surname borrowed from a famous Marvel character who is a doctor and a sorcerer

questions.question_text: In Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, the Illuminati of Earth-838 are each killed by Wanda one by one. In what order are they killed — who dies first and who dies last before Strange escapes?
questions.clue_1: The first death is the most visually shocking — a hero bisected by their own power
questions.clue_2: The last one standing tries to use a weapon against Wanda that she simply absorbs
questions.hint_text: The sequence begins with the most stretched death and ends with a certain captain whose energy powers prove completely useless against the Scarlet Witch's chaos magic
questions.correct_answer: Black Bolt, Mr Fantastic, Captain Carter, Captain Marvel

questions.question_text: In Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2, Ego reveals he has been seeding plants on thousands of planets across the universe as part of his expansion plan. What is the name he gives to this plan?
questions.clue_1: It is named after himself — a fitting choice for a planet-sized ego
questions.clue_2: The plan involves absorbing all matter in the universe into his own being
questions.hint_text: The plan is one word — his own name used as a verb, turned into a cosmic programme of total universal consumption

questions.question_text: In Loki Season 2, the TVA faces collapse and Loki takes a drastic final action to preserve the multiverse. What does Loki ultimately do at the end of Season 2?
questions.clue_1: He cannot save everyone — so he chooses to become something permanent instead
questions.clue_2: His final act involves the Temporal Loom and all the branching timelines
questions.hint_text: He stops trying to save the machine and becomes the machine himself — holding all the branches of the multiverse together from a throne at the end of time

questions.question_text: In What If...? Season 1, the episode featuring Doctor Strange Supreme shows Strange consuming countless beings to gain their power. What was the specific event he was trying to undo that led to his corruption?
questions.clue_1: It was the loss of someone he loved — not his hands
questions.clue_2: No matter how many times he rewound time, this event could not be changed
questions.hint_text: It is called an Absolute Point — a fixed moment in time that cannot be altered no matter what, because her death was the very event that made Strange powerful enough to become Sorcerer Supreme

questions.question_text: In Marvel Comics, the Time Gem allows its user to travel through time freely. Which cosmic villain once stole the Time Gem and used it to go back and prevent the formation of the Avengers?
In the Jessica Jones Netflix series, Kilgrave's mind-control powers stem from a specific virus. What is the name of that virus?
In Marvel Comics, Doctor Strange's mentor the Ancient One was originally depicted as a man from which country — before the MCU changed the character to a Celtic woman?

In the comics, the Time Stone's most famous standalone story involves Strange trapping an enemy in a time loop — predating the MCU film by decades. That story arc is named after which Stephen King novel?
In the Runaways Hulu series, the young heroes discover their parents are part of a secret criminal organisation. What is the name of that organisation?
What is the name of the realm where Hulk fights as a gladiator?
What Infinity Stone is located in the Eye of Agamotto?
What is the name of Captain Marvel's original human identity?
What is the name of the Wakandan herb that grants Black Panther powers?
What is the name of Thanos's home planet?
In Guardians of the Galaxy, the Power Stone is contained inside an orb. Which planet is the orb originally recovered from at the beginning of the film?
questions.clue_1: Peter Quill retrieves it alone from an abandoned and desolate world
questions.clue_2: The planet's name sounds ancient and is associated with a dead civilisation
questions.hint_text: The world is a graveyard of a long-dead species — its name sounds like it belongs to a forgotten mythology, beginning with the letter M

questions.question_text: In Thor: Ragnarok, Sakaar is described as being at the end of a series of portals. What is the specific name given to the type of portal that deposits debris — and people — onto Sakaar?
questions.clue_1: Hulk arrived through one of these portals — and so did many of the arena fighters
questions.clue_2: The name combines two words — one cosmic, one suggesting a hole or passage
questions.hint_text: The portals are named after a phenomenon in space — a colourful word that suggests a tearing or warping of the fabric between dimensions

questions.question_text: In Avengers: Infinity War, Thanos collects the Reality Stone from the Collector on Knowhere. But the scene is a trick — what is actually happening when the Guardians arrive on Knowhere?
questions.clue_1: Thanos has already been and gone before the Guardians arrive
questions.clue_2: What the Guardians see is an illusion created by one of the Infinity Stones already in Thanos's possession
questions.hint_text: The whole scene — the Collector, the chaos, the confrontation — is a fabricated reality created by the Reality Stone, which Thanos had already retrieved before they landed

questions.question_text: In Captain Marvel, Carol Danvers spends years believing she is a Kree warrior named Vers. What is the origin of the name Vers — where does it actually come from?
questions.clue_1: It is a fragment of something she already owned before her memory was erased
questions.clue_2: The name comes from the only surviving piece of identification the Kree found on her
questions.hint_text: It is half a word — the only readable letters left on a broken dog tag from her time as a human pilot, showing only part of her real surname

questions.question_text: In Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2, the Sovereign are a golden-skinned alien race who pursue the Guardians across the galaxy. What caused the Sovereign to begin chasing the Guardians in the first place?
questions.clue_1: The Guardians had just completed a job for the Sovereign — and someone couldn't resist temptation
questions.clue_2: Something valuable was stolen from the Sovereign's vault after the mission was completed
questions.hint_text: Rocket couldn't help himself — he pocketed a handful of the very power cells the Guardians had been hired to protect, which is what set the entire film in motion

questions.question_text: In Avengers: Infinity War, the Children of Thanos are called the Black Order. What are the full names of all four Black Order members who appear in the film?
questions.clue_1: Two of them attack Vision in Edinburgh; two of them go to Knowhere
questions.clue_2: One of them speaks in a whisper; one of them throws a spear
questions.hint_text: There are four — a whispering one, a spear-thrower, a monstrous brute, and a teleporting one; their names are all two words each
questions.correct_answer: Ebony Maw, Cull Obsidian, Proxima Midnight, Corvus Glaive

questions.question_text: In Thor: Ragnarok, Hela reveals she was Odin's firstborn and was imprisoned for her ambition. What was Hela's role in Asgard before she was banished — what was her official title?
questions.clue_1: Her title was given to her by Odin himself during Asgard's early conquests
questions.clue_2: Her role was connected to death itself — she oversaw a specific domain
questions.hint_text: Odin gave her dominion over the dead — she was not just a warrior but the ruler of a realm where the fallen go, a title that reflects total authority over death itself
questions.correct_answer: Goddess of Death / Asgard's Executioner and ruler of Hell

questions.question_text: In the MCU, which object—originally housed within Loki’s scepter—was used by Hydra to experiment on humans, ultimately leading to the creation of enhanced individuals like Scarlet Witch.
questions.clue_1: It is one of a small set of ancient cosmic objects tied to the universe’s creation
questions.clue_2: It changes form across different appearances in the MCU.
questions.hint_text: It is linked to intelligence and awareness.

questions.question_text: In Captain Marvel, the Kree Supreme Intelligence appears to each person as a different figure. Who does the Supreme Intelligence appear as to Carol Danvers — and why?
questions.clue_1: The figure is someone Carol already knows — or thinks she knows
questions.clue_2: The form is chosen because it represents the person Carol most respects or admires from her own memory
questions.hint_text: The Intelligence shows Carol the face of the woman she most admires from her erased past — someone she later realises is key to unlocking her true identity

questions.question_text: In Avengers: Infinity War, Thanos sacrifices Gamora to obtain the Soul Stone on Vormir. Before throwing her over the cliff, he says something to her that reveals he genuinely believes his act is love. What does he say?
questions.clue_1: It is a short sentence — a declaration that frames his grief as proof of his sincerity
questions.clue_2: He uses it to justify the sacrifice — claiming the pain he feels is what makes it valid
questions.hint_text: He tells her that everything he does — including this — comes from a place of love; his tears are offered as evidence that the exchange is real

questions.question_text: In Marvel Comics, the Space Gem was held by which member of the Infinity Watch — the group Adam Warlock assembled after the Infinity Gauntlet saga?
In Marvel Comics’ Spider-Verse storyline, what is the name of the mystical force that grants Spider-Totems their powers and connects all Spider-people across the multiverse?
In the Cloak and Dagger TV series, Tandy Bowen and Tyrone Johnson gain their powers from an explosion connected to which company's illegal experiments?
In Marvel Comics, the Skrulls have a sacred prophecy about a Skrull who will lead them to a new homeworld. What is the name of this prophesied figure?
In Marvel Comics, the planet Sakaar was ruled by the Red King before Hulk arrived. What is the Red King's real name?
What is the name of the TVA's main governing entity?
What is the name of Loki's weapon containing the Mind Stone?
What is the name of the prison used in Guardians of the Galaxy?
What is the name of the scientist who created Ultron with Tony Stark?
What is the name of Gamora's adoptive father?
In Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, America Chavez has a unique power. What exactly is her ability — and what triggers it involuntarily?
questions.clue_1: She cannot fully control her power yet at the start of the film
questions.clue_2: Her power activates under a specific emotional condition — one she cannot easily suppress
questions.hint_text: She punches holes between universes — but only when she is afraid, a power that has followed her since childhood and cost her everything she loved

questions.question_text: In Loki, the Time Variance Authority is revealed to be built on a lie. What is the specific lie that Mobius and the TVA agents discover about themselves?
questions.clue_1: Their entire personal history is fabricated
questions.clue_2: Every TVA agent is actually something they were told they were not
questions.hint_text: They were told they were created by the Time Keepers — but the truth is they are all variants, ordinary people plucked from the timeline and brainwashed into believing they were born to serve

questions.question_text: In Thor: The Dark World, the Aether bonds with Jane Foster. Why does the Aether choose Jane — what is the specific circumstance that leads to the Aether entering her body?
questions.clue_1: Jane stumbles upon it during a period of unusual cosmic alignment
questions.clue_2: She discovers it in an abandoned location connected to an ancient convergence
questions.hint_text: She falls through a crack in reality during the Convergence and finds the Aether hidden in a stone column — it enters her because it was seeking a host and she was simply the first living thing to touch it

questions.question_text: In Spider-Man: No Way Home, Doctor Strange attempts to cast a memory-erasing spell so the world forgets Peter Parker is Spider-Man. The spell goes wrong because of what Peter keeps doing?
questions.clue_1: Peter keeps interrupting the spell mid-cast
questions.clue_2: Each interruption adds an exception to the spell — expanding who it reaches
questions.hint_text: Every time Peter asks Strange to spare someone — MJ, Ned, Aunt May — the spell absorbs the exception and grows unstable, eventually reaching across the entire multiverse

questions.question_text: In Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania, Kang the Conqueror is trapped in the Quantum Realm. What is the name of the city he built inside the Quantum Realm that he rules over?
questions.clue_1: It is a vast technologically advanced city suspended in the subatomic world
questions.clue_2: Its name is a single word that references the nature of time and fate
questions.hint_text: The city's name evokes inevitability and the passage of time — a single word that feels like a prophecy carved in stone

questions.question_text: In WandaVision, the Hex that Wanda creates over Westview has a very specific shape when viewed from above. What shape is it, and what is the significance of that shape to Wanda's powers?
questions.clue_1: The shape is visible in drone footage captured by S.W.O.R.D.
questions.clue_2: The shape mirrors something found in chaos magic symbolism and on Wanda's forehead as Scarlet Witch
questions.hint_text: The boundary of Wanda's Hex is shaped like a hexagon — and the rune on her forehead and in chaos magic is the same six-sided form, tying her power to this geometric symbol

questions.question_text: In Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, Wanda uses a dreamwalk to possess her Earth-838 counterpart. Strange counters by also dreamwalking — but into a very unusual host. Whose corpse does Strange possess to fight Wanda?
questions.clue_1: The host was a version of Strange from another universe — one who had already died
questions.clue_2: This Strange had used the Darkhold and paid a visible price — a third eye had opened on his forehead
questions.hint_text: He inhabits the dead body of the Defender Strange from the film's opening — the Strange who died protecting America Chavez, and whose corpse had been preserved in the ruins of a destroyed universe

questions.question_text: In Avengers: Age of Ultron, Ultron's final plan involves lifting an entire city into the sky and dropping it onto Earth like a meteor. What is the name of the city he uses for this plan?
questions.clue_1: It is a small European city — not a major capital
questions.clue_2: It was already associated with the Avengers before Ultron chose it
questions.hint_text: The city's name is one that the Sokovia Accords were later named after — a place that became synonymous with collateral damage and the cost of superhero battles

questions.question_text: In Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania, Kang reveals he has been banished to the Quantum Realm by other variants of himself. What does he call the collective group of his variants who exiled him?
questions.clue_1: They are a council of Kangs — every version of him from across the multiverse
questions.clue_2: The name they use for themselves references a specific concept of conquest and dominion
questions.hint_text: They call themselves by a name that sounds like a council of rulers — a title that emphasises that every one of them is, at their core, a conqueror

questions.question_text: In Loki Season 1, Sylvie and Loki discover the person behind the TVA after reaching the Citadel at the End of Time. What is the name of the place at the very end of time where He Who Remains lives?
questions.clue_1: It sits at the terminus of all timelines — the very last point in existence
questions.clue_2: Its name suggests both a place of final authority and a kind of eternal waiting
questions.hint_text: The name combines a word for a seat of absolute power with a word that means the very end — a fortress at the conclusion of all things
questions.correct_answer: The Citadel at the End of Time

questions.question_text: In Marvel Comics, the Reality Gem was held by which member of the Infinity Watch after the Infinity Gauntlet saga?
In the comics Secret Invasion storyline, which hero is revealed to have been replaced by a Skrull for an extended period — and was the Skrull considered a hero or villain by other Skrulls?
In the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. TV series, what is the name of the Kree artifact that can resurrect the dead — and what catastrophic side effect does it have on humans?
In Marvel Comics, the multiverse designation for the main Marvel Comics universe is a specific number. What is that number?
In the comic storyline House of M, Wanda reshapes all of reality with three words. What are those three words?
What is the name of the sorcerer sanctuary in New York?
What is the name of the mirror-like training dimension used by sorcerers?
What is the name of the prison where enhanced individuals are held underwater?
What Infinity Stone is hidden inside the Tesseract?
What is the name of Thor's hammer before Stormbreaker?

In Black Widow, Natasha confronts the Red Room one final time. The Red Room's Widows are controlled via a chemical that keeps them under Dreykov's command. What is the name of the substance used to free them?
questions.clue_1: Natasha had to break her own nose to escape Dreykov's pheromone lock
questions.clue_2: The antidote is delivered via an arrow — fired by a very familiar face
questions.hint_text: The substance is delivered like a vaccination — injected remotely via arrows fired by someone Natasha trained alongside, shattering the chemical mind-control holding every Widow

questions.question_text: In Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings, Xu Wenwu has wielded the Ten Rings for over a thousand years. What does he believe is calling to him from behind the mystical gates of Ta Lo — and what is it actually?
questions.clue_1: He believes it is his deceased wife calling to him from beyond death
questions.clue_2: The voice is not what he thinks — it belongs to something imprisoned and very dangerous
questions.hint_text: He hears what he believes is the voice of the woman he loved — but it is the voice of an ancient soul-devouring creature that uses the dead's voices to lure the living into opening its prison

questions.question_text: In The Falcon and the Winter Soldier, a new character takes up the Captain America mantle after Sam Wilson relinquishes the shield. What is his name?
questions.clue_1: The act happens in public, on camera, and immediately goes viral
questions.clue_2: It is a brutal act that involves using the shield as a weapon on a downed opponent
questions.hint_text: He beats a man to death with the vibranium shield in front of a crowd — on camera — shattering the image of Captain America in a single moment of rage

questions.question_text: In Ms. Marvel, Kamala Khan discovers her powers are connected to her family history. What specific object unlocks her abilities at the beginning of the series?
questions.clue_1: It is a piece of jewellery that belonged to her great-grandmother
questions.clue_2: It is found in a box of belongings sent from Pakistan
questions.hint_text: It looks like a simple bangle — an old piece of jewellery from her ancestral past — but when Kamala puts it on, it triggers something dormant in her genes

questions.question_text: In Eternals, the team discovers the true purpose of their mission on Earth. What is the real reason the Eternals were sent to Earth by the Celestials — the truth they had been kept from knowing?
questions.clue_1: It has nothing to do with protecting humanity from Deviants
questions.clue_2: The true purpose involves the growth of a new Celestial inside the Earth's core
questions.hint_text: They were never protectors — they were farmers, nurturing the human population to grow large enough to provide the energy needed to birth a new Celestial sleeping inside Earth's molten core

questions.question_text: In Avengers: Endgame, Steve Rogers travels back in time to return all six Infinity Stones to their original points in history. To whom must he return the one from Vormir?
questions.clue_1: He has to return six stones to multiple time periods
questions.clue_2: someone is always waiting there
questions.hint_text: In Vormir he must face the keeper once more — the cursed guardian who directed Natasha and Clint to their sacrifice, now watching an old man return what was paid for in blood

questions.question_text: In Thor: Love and Thunder, Jane Foster wields Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor. She is revealed to be dying — and Mjolnir is accelerating her illness. Why does she keep using it despite knowing this?
questions.clue_1: She understands the cost completely — she is not deceived about the danger
questions.clue_2: Her reason is both personal and selfless — connected to who she is and what she believes is worth doing
questions.hint_text: She knows that every transformation kills a little more of her — but she also knows that wielding the hammer gives her the only moments in which she feels like herself again, powerful enough to matter

questions.question_text: In Moon Knight, Marc Spector and Steven Grant discover a third personality sharing their body during their time in the Duat. What is the name of this third alter, and what is significant about when he was created?
questions.clue_1: This personality is more violent and dangerous than either Marc or Steven
questions.clue_2: He was created to protect a very young child from an unbearable trauma
questions.hint_text: He is a third face behind the mirror — born from the worst night of Marc's childhood to absorb the pain of something no child should survive

questions.question_text: In Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3, Rocket Raccoon's backstory is finally revealed in full. Who created Rocket?
questions.clue_1: The creator is a scientist obsessed with a specific philosophical idea about life and perfection
questions.clue_2: Rocket was not the first experiment — there were others before him, including those he befriended in captivity
questions.hint_text: His creator called himself the High Evolutionary and ran a programme of biological experimentation aimed at creating a perfect race — Rocket was subject 89P13, his most successful and despised creation

questions.question_text: In Hawkeye, Clint Barton's past as the vigilante Ronin comes back to haunt him. What specific event caused Clint to become Ronin after the Snap — and who does he target during his time as Ronin?
questions.clue_1: He lost everyone he loved in the Snap and responded with a decision to kill
questions.clue_2: He chose to target people who he felt had no right to survive when good people were taken
questions.hint_text: With his family gone, Clint decided the Snap had been unfair — and spent five years hunting down and killing criminals, cartel leaders, and gang members who had survived when his family had not

questions.question_text: In Marvel Comics, the Soul Gem was the first Infinity Gem to appear in publication. Which character first possessed it and used it to steal the souls of other heroes?
In the Punisher Netflix series, Frank Castle's true target is a covert black ops programme. What is the name of that programme?
In Marvel Comics, Peter Parker once operated without his Spider-Man identity while his body was inhabited by another person. Who took over Peter's body and operated as Spider-Man in his place?
In the Iron Fist Netflix series, the Hand's true leader is revealed not to be Madame Gao but another character. Who is ultimately revealed to be the leader of the Hand?
In Marvel Comics, Gamora is known as the deadliest woman in the universe. Who trained her and gave her cybernetic enhancements to make her the perfect assassin — before Thanos adopted her?
